US orders diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attack fears

The United States has ordered non-emergency embassy staff and their families to leave Saudi Arabia due to escalating Houthi attacks. Drone debris from an attack killed two people, and an Indian national was among those injured. The US is also preparing to recall members from other West Asian countries. The move comes amid rising fears of escalating Houthi attacks in the region. Separately, the UK has sent jets to Saudi Arabia for 'defensive activity' in response to what it called 'intolerable Houthi escalation'. Oil prices rose as geopolitical concerns returned to focus.
